summary: Validated 2 follow-up fixes: (1) French phone prefix dropdown now works — 12 FR/DOM-TOM options rendered via data-testid='field-phone-prefix'; selecting 🇬🇵 Guadeloupe (+590) + typing '0690001122' submits a lead stored as '+590690001122' in Mongo. France (+33) default also works ('+33612345678'). (2) Meta Pixel loads WITHOUT consent: on fresh page load (localStorage/sessionStorage cleared) window.fbq becomes a function, fbevents.js + signals/config/1905482920834524 are requested, and window.__metaPixelEvents immediately contains {event:'PageView',pixel_id:'1905482920834524'}. After a successful 2-step form submit a single {event:'Lead',pixel_id:'1905482920834524'} is appended (no duplicates). Consent banner is now a simple cookies notice: visible at bottom with 'Accepter' button, dismissed on click, and does NOT reappear after reload (persisted via localStorage 'claude_cookie_notice'='1'). Backend pytest regression: 25/25 pass (sequentially). Admin UI (Meta pixel manager & leads list) still functional.

minor.issue: Default rate_limit_per_hour=8 is very low: parallel pytest-xdist run triggers 429s on the last 2 lead-deletion tests. Sequential run (-o addopts='') passes 25/25. Not a product bug but hurts CI determinism — bump_rate_limit fixture should run per-worker or tests should serialize lead creation.

action_items: Optional: make the bump_rate_limit pytest fixture compatible with pytest-xdist (e.g. remove -n from pytest.ini addopts or make the fixture apply once via a lock file) to avoid flaky 429 under parallel runs.
critical_code_review_comments: metaPixel.js header comment still says 'chargement UNIQUEMENT après consentement' but the behavior is now 'load always'. Update the comment to avoid misleading future readers.

FR_PREFIXES contains two labels mapping to '+262' (Réunion & Mayotte) and three mapping to '+590' (Guadeloupe, St-Barth, St-Martin). The composed phone is identical for duplicates — fine for E.164 but the backend will not distinguish territory in phone_e164 (acceptable since phonenumbers normalizes to the same prefix).
ConsentBanner is purely cosmetic now (no gating). Consider renaming to CookieNotice for clarity.
DynamicForm.PhoneField initial state ignores subsequent prop updates (deps intentionally empty) — fine for current use (never prefilled).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (phone dropdown, GP submit, FR submit, pixel-without-consent, banner persistence, PageView=1 & Lead=1)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST leads via UI (test.gp681622@gmail.com +590690001122, test.fr802843@gmail.com +33612345678) + many pytest leads with gmail.com addresses. Backend settings were temporarily set to rate_limit_per_hour=1000/min_submit_seconds=0 for UI tests and then restored to defaults (8 / 3 / 30).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixes verified. If re-running pytest in parallel (default pytest.ini uses -n via xdist), the last 2 lead-deletion tests may 429. Use `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' -v` to run sequentially. Default admin settings are 8 leads/hr/IP + 3s min_submit — bump via /api/admin/settings before any heavy UI submit testing.
rca of the issue: N/A — both reported fixes work as specified. Pixel loads unconditionally in useMetaPixel (LandingPage.js L71-95); PageView guarded by pageViewFired ref + sessionStorage key; Lead guarded by leadFired ref and called from DynamicForm's onConversion after successful POST /api/leads. Phone field uses PhoneField component with FR_PREFIXES select + composePhone helper (strips leading 0, prepends +<code>) → backend normalize_phone_fr accepts all FR + DOM-TOM country codes.
